items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: after Don Redmond left the McKinney's Cotton Pickers and fixed his own, and took his own band. And he, you see, he, he was the first guy that, uh, first guy to really bring out the, uh, five, five saxophones

ctx.x: Well did you play, you said you played mostly dance tunes, but did you play, you played some ragtime on the boat?

Oh yes, well on the boat, when we first started, of course the music, the music on the boat changed, you see, from the jazz music, from what they call ragtime, because when we, after we got them saxophones, of course we changed the whole, after they switched from where they had the trumpets, plainly, to where they had the saxophones, the whole style of music changed. As a matter of fact, the whole style of writing music changed. You see, when, if I can remember rightly, I think the first, the first, first of the…
